mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM ( CHT_ROM_ID, LEC_ID, LMS_PRF_ID, CHT_ROM_REG_DATE, CHT_ROM_VAL_STATUS ) SELECT SEQ_CHAT_ROOM.NEXTVAL, e.LEC_ID, e.LMS_PRF_ID, SYSTIMESTAMP, 'ACT' FROM LECTURE l JOIN LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e ON e.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID WHERE l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHAT_ROOM cr WHERE cr.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID AND cr.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID AND cr.CHT_ROM_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' )
mapper.sql: cr.CHT_ROM_ID AS roomId, cr.LEC_ID AS lecId, cr.LMS_PRF_ID AS studentLmsPrfId, l.LMS_PRF_ID AS professorLmsPrfId, sm.MEMBER_NAME AS studentName, sm.LOGIN_ID AS studentNo, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, COALESCE( ( SELECT lm.CHT_ROM_MSG_CONTENT FROM CHAT_ROOM_MESSAGES lm WHERE lm.CHT_ROM_ID = cr.CHT_ROM_ID AND lm.CHT_ROM_MSG_STATUS != 'DEL' ORDER BY lm.CHT_ROM_MSG_DATE DESC, lm.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ), '아직 메시지가 없습니다.' ) AS lastMessage, COALESCE( ( SELECT TO_CHAR(lm.CHT_ROM_MSG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') FROM CHAT_ROOM_MESSAGES lm WHERE lm.CHT_ROM_ID = cr.CHT_ROM_ID AND lm.CHT_ROM_MSG_STATUS != 'DEL' ORDER BY lm.CHT_ROM_MSG_DATE DESC, lm.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ), TO_CHAR(cr.CHT_ROM_REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ) AS lastAt, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM_MESSAGES um LEFT JOIN ROOM_MESSAGES_READ rr ON rr.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID = um.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID WHERE um.CHT_ROM_ID = cr.CHT_ROM_ID AND um.LMS_PRF_ID != #{professorLmsPrfId} AND um.CHT_ROM_MSG_STATUS != 'DEL' AND NVL(rr.ROM_MSG_RED_YN, 0) = 0 ) AS unread
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM CHAT_ROOM cr JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = cr.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e ON e.LEC_ID = cr.LEC_ID AND e.LMS_PRF_ID = cr.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN LMS_PROFILE sp ON sp.LMS_PRF_ID = cr.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER sm ON sm.MEMBER_ID = sp.MEMBER_ID WHERE l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} AND cr.CHT_ROM_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' ORDER BY lastAt DESC, cr.CHT_ROM_ID DESC

SELECT
FROM CHAT_ROOM cr JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = cr.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e ON e.LEC_ID = cr.LEC_ID AND e.LMS_PRF_ID = cr.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN LMS_PROFILE sp ON sp.LMS_PRF_ID = cr.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER sm ON sm.MEMBER_ID = sp.MEMBER_ID WHERE cr.CHT_ROM_ID = #{roomId} AND l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} AND cr.CHT_ROM_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP'

SELECT m.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID AS id, m.CHT_ROM_ID AS roomId, m.LMS_PRF_ID AS senderLmsPrfId, CASE WHEN m.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} THEN 'me' ELSE 'student' END AS sender, m.CHT_ROM_MSG_CONTENT AS text, TO_CHAR(m.CHT_ROM_MSG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS sentAt, CASE WHEN NVL(rr.ROM_MSG_RED_YN, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS read FROM CHAT_ROOM_MESSAGES m LEFT JOIN ROOM_MESSAGES_READ rr ON rr.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID = m.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID WHERE m.CHT_ROM_ID = #{roomId} AND m.CHT_ROM_MSG_STATUS != 'DEL' ORDER BY m.CHT_ROM_MSG_DATE ASC, m.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID ASC
mapper.update: MERGE INTO ROOM_MESSAGES_READ rr USING ( SELECT m.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID FROM CHAT_ROOM_MESSAGES m WHERE m.CHT_ROM_ID = #{roomId} AND m.LMS_PRF_ID != #{professorLmsPrfId} AND m.CHT_ROM_MSG_STATUS != 'DEL' ) src ON (rr.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID = src.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET rr.ROM_MSG_RED_YN = 1, rr.ROM_MSG_RED_REG_DATE = COALESCE(rr.ROM_MSG_RED_REG_DATE, SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE rr.ROM_MSG_RED_YN = 0 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ROM_MSG_RED_ID, CHT_ROM_MSG_ID, ROM_MSG_RED_REG_DATE, ROM_MSG_RED_YN ) VALUES ( SEQ_ROOM_MESSAGES_READ.NEXTVAL, src.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID, SYSTIMESTAMP, 1 )

SELECT SEQ_CHAT_ROOM_MESSAGES.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM_MESSAGES ( CHT_ROM_MSG_ID, CHT_ROM_ID, LMS_PRF_ID, CHT_ROM_MSG_DATE, CHT_ROM_MSG_CONTENT, CHT_ROM_MSG_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{roomId}, #{senderLmsPrfId}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{text}, 'SNT' )
INSERT INTO ROOM_MESSAGES_READ ( ROM_MSG_RED_ID, CHT_ROM_MSG_ID, ROM_MSG_RED_REG_DATE, ROM_MSG_RED_YN ) VALUES ( SEQ_ROOM_MESSAGES_READ.NEXTVAL, #{messageId}, NULL, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT m.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID AS id, m.CHT_ROM_ID AS roomId, m.LMS_PRF_ID AS senderLmsPrfId, CASE WHEN m.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} THEN 'me' ELSE 'student' END AS sender, m.CHT_ROM_MSG_CONTENT AS text, TO_CHAR(m.CHT_ROM_MSG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS sentAt, CASE WHEN NVL(rr.ROM_MSG_RED_YN, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS read FROM CHAT_ROOM_MESSAGES m LEFT JOIN ROOM_MESSAGES_READ rr ON rr.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID = m.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID WHERE m.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID = #{messageId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM cr JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = cr.LEC_ID JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MESSAGES m ON m.CHT_ROM_ID = cr.CHT_ROM_ID LEFT JOIN ROOM_MESSAGES_READ rr ON rr.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID = m.CHT_ROM_MSG_ID JOIN LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e ON e.LEC_ID = cr.LEC_ID AND e.LMS_PRF_ID = cr.LMS_PRF_ID WHERE l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} AND cr.CHT_ROM_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' AND m.LMS_PRF_ID != #{professorLmsPrfId} AND m.CHT_ROM_MSG_STATUS != 'DEL' AND NVL(rr.ROM_MSG_RED_YN, 0) = 0
